commit_message: Align canonical authoring docs with current ADRs
pr_title: GameEngine: resolve ADR audit conflicts on current main
pr_body:
## Summary

- rebuild the ADR audit on the current main baseline
- resolve duplicate ADR 0122/0123 identities by moving the later Accepted renderer decisions to 0128/0129
- preserve Proposed ADRs 0122-0127, including Native 2D
- reorganize the ADR registry and add the current architecture/audit documents
- align the canonical authoring specification and ADR 0113 operational wording with current Accepted ADRs and metadata-derived CI planning

This supersedes stale-base PR #36. Documentation only; no runtime behavior, serialized schema, Stable ID, public Rust API, or crate dependency changes.
